threads.body: This adds public `GenAIInvocation.context` and `TelemetryHandler.tool(..., context=...)` APIs to `opentelemetry-util-genai`, but the PR only includes a changelog fragment for the LlamaIndex package. Repository policy requires user-visible changes to be recorded in the affected package; please add `util/opentelemetry-util-genai/.changelog/704.added` describing these APIs (the existing LlamaIndex fragment can remain for its behavior change).
